objective.name: largest N with a two-coloring of [1,N] containing no monochromatic 7-term arithmetic progression
constraints: the domain is exactly the consecutive prefix [1,N]
each integer receives exactly one of two colors
a forbidden progression has seven distinct terms and a positive integer common difference
